title: Erasing a Scratch Tape Cell
statement: For natural numbers $q$ and $j$, define a Boolean-valued partial tape that contains true exactly at integer positions $z$ satisfying $j\le z<q$. Updating this tape at position $j$ to blank gives the tape whose true cells are exactly the positions $z$ satisfying $j+1\le z<q$.
